weather_line: Warm and still in the hollows · six ducks outstanding

stories.headline: Mrs. Holt's Seventh Duck Arrives by Post; Hat Is a Deerstalker; the Postowl Refuses to Leave Without Admiring It First
body: Duck the seventh — soft grey, hand-stuffed, carrying the unmistakable posture of a duck that knows things — arrived at the household Saturday evening via post-owl, forty minutes behind schedule. Witnesses report the owl set the parcel down on the Jeep's bonnet, stepped back, and regarded the completed duck for an interval best described as 'professional.' The hat, a miniature deerstalker in brown herringbone with a functioning magnifying-charm sewn into the peak, is understood to be Mrs. Holt's most technically accomplished millinery to date.

A note accompanied the parcel, written in Mrs. Holt's characteristically spare hand: 'This one is for the detective. You know which one.' The household has reached no formal consensus on which member of the family is being addressed. Lucy has not commented, which several sources describe as itself a form of comment.

The Jeep, now carrying seven ducks in formation along its rear quarter, has been described by passing neighbours as looking 'purposeful.' Steve has begun a separate log of hats. Five ducks remain at the ridge.

serial.title: The Six Remaining Ducks of Elspeth Holt

stories.headline: Sunday Rest Observed at Gringotts; Goblins Not Observed Resting; Christine Observed Resting Correctly and Without Apology
body: In a development the Prophet's Gringotts correspondent has waited six weeks to report, Senior Client Liaison Christine took a full Sunday morning away from the ledgers, the pending correspondence, and the three items in the pending tray that have been 'nearly finished' since the fourteenth. The tray will keep. Gringotts, per tradition, does not close; however, without Christine present to run the day at speed, operations are understood to be proceeding at approximately normal pace, which observers note is measurably slower and considerably louder.
Griphook the Younger was reached for comment. He issued none, but did straighten slightly upon being told the Senior Liaison would be in Monday morning. This is considered high praise.

stories.headline: The Newly Installed Kitchen Shelf Holds Seven Items; Steve Adds an Eighth; Shelf Holds the Eighth; a Line Has Been Drawn
body: Following last Saturday's successful installation of the kitchen shelf — which resisted, then reconsidered, then capitulated entirely — the shelf passed its first full week of service without incident. Seven items were placed upon it in ascending order of weight as a condition of the provisional peace. Steve added an eighth item Sunday morning, a cast-iron herb pot of unambiguous heft, on the grounds that 'it looked like it fit.' The shelf, for its part, held.
Christine has nevertheless made a note. The note is on the refrigerator. The shelf is aware of the refrigerator.

stories.headline: Ellie Spends Forty Minutes Making Friends with the Garden Window; Window Is Non-Committal; Ellie Remains Optimistic
body: Ellie, the household's sweetest and most comprehensively baffled familiar, spent the better part of Sunday afternoon in what the household is calling 'a diplomatic initiative' directed at the south-facing garden window. She approached the glass, registered the presence of another dog, wagged, retreated, wagged again, and sat down to wait for a development.

No development occurred. Ellie has interpreted this as the early stages of a meaningful friendship and returned to the window twice since dinner. The window remains at large. Ellie's optimism, sources confirm, is entirely undiminished and probably unkillable.

familiars_corner: Lucy: The deerstalker duck arrived Saturday and Lucy was in the garden when the owl landed, yet somehow she had already reviewed it by the time Steve came to collect the parcel. No explanation has been offered. None will be.
Ellie: Made a new friend in the window today. The friend is shy and only visits during daylight. Ellie finds this completely reasonable and has saved her half of the biscuit anyway.

Jersey: Located the warmest available Sunday lap by seven-fifteen in the morning and did not vacate it until the lap went to make tea, at which point Jersey relocated to the second warmest lap with the smooth efficiency of a professional.
founding_editor_note: Deerstalker. Good hat. Built solid, that kind — I had one like it for the roof job in '84. Kept the rain out and the thinking in. That duck knows what it's about. — D.

in_brief.sport: The kitchen shelf's eighth consecutive successful hold has been submitted to the Household Structural Records Office; a formal citation is pending.
in_brief.forecast: Warm through the hollows, still on the ridge; post-owls running slow; duck number eight expected mid-week; bring a hat to appreciate.

storyline_updates.title: The Six Remaining Ducks of Elspeth Holt
storyline_updates.summary: Day 2: Duck the seventh has arrived by post-owl — a herringbone deerstalker with a magnifying-charm peak. The accompanying note ('This one is for the detective. You know which one.') is unresolved; the household has not agreed on its referent; Lucy has declined to clarify. Steve has begun a dedicated hat log. Five ducks remain at the ridge. Day 3 should bring either a further duck or a new detail about Mrs. Holt's history — perhaps Steve visits the ridge again, or she mentions why she started hatting ducks in the first place, edging toward whatever the arc's final revelation will be.
